entry.title: U.S. Bank Tower
entry.note: Signed mapped whole outline and all eleven adjoining tower parts retain the different setback directions, including the long eastern/western curves. Fifth Street entrance is on the southwest side toward the library. GroundY0 is the lower Fifth Street entry; surrounding Bunker Hill Steps and uphill terrain remain separate site context. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
